<div class="card-body">
'''Tauntaun Handler''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">トーントーン使い</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">騎乗する乗用生物の戦闘力に2を加える。トーントーンに乗っているなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に1枚引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Tauntaun-Handler-SWCA-100694.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コーマン・クィエンはエコー基地の偵察兵の典型と言える。野生のトーントーンを捕まえ、手なずけ、訓練を行うのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tauntaun Handler.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of any creature vehicle he rides. If he is on a tauntaun, he may draw one battle destiny when not otherwise able to.

'''Lore:'''
Corman Quien is a typical scout at Echo Base. He captures, tames, and trains wild tauntauns.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says he rides a creature vehicle; the English says he drives it.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tauntaun Handler]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
